release_notes:
1. Fixed false select_item trigger when removing products on Checkout / Cart (excluded cart action triggers and deletion URLs from select_item).
2. Universal remove_from_cart tracking across all checkout types (including ETS One Page Checkout, standard PrestaShop, slide-out mini-carts, and cart pages).
3. Zero DOM data resolution: product data resolved strictly from backend memory or AJAX controller.
4. Network-level XHR and Fetch interceptors with deduplication guards to ensure accurate, single remove_from_cart event emission.
